Satellite name M-ARGO (Miniaturised Asteroid Remote Geophysical Observer)
Form factor CubeSat
Units or mass 12U
Status not launched, expected in 2027
Launcher not launched
Entity name ESA (European Space Agency)
Institution Space agency
Entity type Government (Civil / Military)
Nation (HQ) France
Nation (AIT) Denmark
Manufacturer AIVT by GomSpace
Partners Luxembourg Space Agency, GomSpace
Costs $450,000 for Phase-A
Oneliner

Rendezvous with an asteroid and characterise the physical properties.
Description

Rendezvous with an asteroid. Characterise the physical properties of asteroid (shape, surface, mass). Assess potential for resource exploitation (composition, hydration). Multi-Spectral Imager and LASER Altimeter.

Demonstrating critical technologies & operations for stand-alone deep space CubeSats in the relevant environment, and rendezvous with a Near Earth Object.
